The '''Republic of Perasta''' is a constitutional republic associated with anti-Astorian politics and the [[Pesteran-Astorian War]].

== State Profile ==

The extracted country source gives Talborn as the capital and 1793 as the establishment date. It also identifies Theorin, Old Theorin, and Old Perastan as major languages.

== Anti-Astorian Memory ==

Perasta's source material strongly emphasizes hostility toward [[Astoria]]. Its old national motto is anti-Astorian, and the patriotic song ''Come out ye' black and whites'' is tied to the Pesteran-Astorian War.

== Naming Note ==

The source set varies between Perasta, Pestera, Perastan, and Pesteran forms. This draft uses ''Republic of Perasta'' as the article title because it is the extracted country-page title, while keeping other forms as aliases until the user fixes the canonical naming.
